adaptation_rules: Project/user decisions outrank imported suggestions. TikTok, LinkedIn and SEO methods are not Douyin policy.
Use one seller problem with verifiable evidence, immediate payoff and one next step.
Learn narration/action synchronization and continuous object transformations, not copy logos, footage, music or brand styling.
No arbitrary 60/30/10 calendar, fixed viral threshold, unverified traffic forecasts, mass scraping, repeated reposts or engagement automation.
Preserve platform AI declarations, accepted narration direction and no burned-in production-method notes.
